newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chip stocks off opening highs, techs up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chip stocks off opening highs, techs up.

text.p: The Dow industrials backed down from opening highs on Monday, consolidating some its recent gains as the equities market digested earnings reports.

"The market is flip-flopping around, looking at earnings as they come out," Jim Benning, a trader at BT Brokerage said. "We could see some consolidation in the market for the next few days. The direction seems to be up, but we have made strong gains recently, which the market must consolidate."
Technology stocks continued to gain after a strong performance on Friday. The Nasdaq composite added around 10 points to 1513.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up around six points at 7927, off a session high of 7945.
It was slightly burdened by softness in the long bond, which declined 9/32 to yield 6.55 percent.
Among corporate results, NationsBank Corp posted second quarter earnings of $1.05 per share versus $1.00 per share in the year-ago quarter. Its stock rose one to 67-5/8.
CPC International Inc reported a second quarter operating loss of $0.04 per share compared with a profit of $0.94 per share. Its stock gained 1-5/16 to 96-13/16.
